# Local font-decoding assets

`typr-md5.js` is an unchanged copy of `extension-research/daxuesoutijiang-edge/lib/TyprMd5.js`.
SHA-256: `04c4a84aacb9da4df12ba40b9d4ad515bafe6d30e4627438636edb670b755795`.
Its original header identifies the following fixed upstream components. The optional
HarfBuzz initializer is not used; the decoder makes no network requests.

## Glyph hash data, version 20220515.1

`cx-glyph-map.js` contains only literal data extracted from Parcel module `3ErB5`
of the locally obtained `SideBar.d70b0916.js`, without running the extension.
The module explicitly supplies these metadata fields:

```json
{"author":"wyn665817","namespace":"wyn665817@163.com","license":"MIT","version":"20220515.1"}
```

No copyright year or separate license body was supplied with that table. Its
MIT declaration and author attribution are preserved here without inventing a year.
The author's public script also declares MIT and identifies the same author:
https://greasyfork.org/zh-CN/scripts/445007-%E8%B6%85%E6%98%9F%E5%AD%97%E4%BD%93%E8%A7%A3%E5%AF%86/code

The MIT permission and warranty terms are reproduced above. Exact source offsets,
source/file hashes and entry count are recorded in `font-assets.json`.
